title: R14,000 December pay: split it like this #Budget
text:
Lindiwe (an illustration) takes home R14,000. Her December pay lands on 15 December, the next on 29 January. Step one: list everything due before then: rent R4,000, debit orders R900, taxi fare R2,400, groceries R4,500, back to school R1,200. That's R13,000. Step two: pay January first, into a separate savings pocket. Step three: her festive budget is what's left, R1,000, plus her R6,000 stokvel payout: R7,000. Step four: keep a R1,000 cushion for surprises.

Full guide: "Festive Season on a Budget: How Not to Start January Broke (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
